questions.question: What is a renewable energy source? Explain how a wind turbine makes electricity.
questions.expected_answer: A renewable energy source is replaced naturally and will not run out, like sunlight, wind and moving water. In a wind turbine, the wind pushes on the long curved blades and makes them turn. They turn a shaft connected through gears to a generator at the top of the tower, which changes movement energy into electrical energy.

questions.question: Describe two ways of making electricity from sunlight, and give one advantage and one disadvantage of solar power.
questions.expected_answer: Solar panels contain solar cells that change light energy directly into electrical energy. Concentrating solar power stations use many mirrors to focus sunlight onto one spot, making heat that boils water into steam, which spins a turbine and generator. Advantage: sunlight is free, will not run out, and makes no smoke while working. Disadvantage: no electricity at night and less on cloudy days, so batteries are needed, and solar farms need a lot of land.

questions.question: How does a hydro power station work, and why can South Africa not rely on it much?
questions.expected_answer: A dam holds back a river, and water let through pipes in the dam wall rushes down and spins turbines, which turn generators to make electricity, as at the Gariep Dam. South Africa has few big rivers and often has droughts, so it cannot make much hydropower, and building dams floods land and changes rivers.
